title: Grader Verdict
description: The rubric result a grader writes into the `structured_output` of state/results/<task-id>.grader-r<round>.json (.claude/agents/grader.md, 'Output contract'). It validates the verdict, not the envelope around it: the envelope is a result and validates against result.schema.json. `status` and `overall` are plain structural enums, not taxonomy dimensions — they describe whether a criterion was met, not a controlled-vocabulary classification (architecture §8 draws that line at classification fields only). `round` is capped at 2 because the grader's loop is a hard stop at two rounds, not a suggestion.
